core.title: Storm and Jalousie Crash Chain with Vinyl Cover
tags: dccv607 crash chain with vinyl cover

text.description_html:
Door Crash Chain with Vinyl Cover

This storm and jalousie door chain guard's total length is 24". A durable crash chain helps to safely prevent a door from opening to far. The spring portion acts as a shock absorber. It is especially good for outside doors where weather and wind can be strong year round. The included protective vinyl covering will not mar your door or scratch the glass. It also prevents the chain from rattling. Includes new mounting hardware. It is simple, inexpensive, and yet very effective.

Specifcations of the Door Crash Chain with Cover:

  • Total Length: 24"
  • Finish: Zinc Plated
  • Packaged with mounting hardware

Sold Individually
